main_topics.reason: The user said their pain was returning and repeatedly described the pill-free week as the worst time.
The user asked for the full range of alternatives, explored several options, and asked what to try first.
The user said they were tired of treatment always being about hormones and asked whether anything else was available.
The user explained that endometriosis was found on the ovary and near the bowel and asked whether that changed treatment choices.
The user said they had been discharged to the GP after surgery and felt this was unsatisfactory given where the disease was found.
The user asked whether this option would require private care and included it in their list for the GP.

output.summary: The user described endometriosis pain returning on the combined pill, especially during the break week, and asked about hormonal and non-hormonal options, including how disease found on the ovary and near the bowel might affect choices. The assistant outlined options and suggested discussing continuous pill use, other treatments, specialist re-referral, and pelvic floor physiotherapy with the GP; the user said they had a proper list and felt less stuck.
